reproduction_target: ddRAD population-genomic analysis of 2,660 Sebastes mentella / S. fasciatus / S. norvegicus specimens from the Gulf of St. Lawrence - Laurentian Channel: read QC (FastQC, MultiQC), adapter trimming (Trimmomatic), demultiplexing and reference-based genotyping with STACKS v2.55 (process_radtags, gstacks, populations) against the chromosome-level Sebastes aleutianus genome via BWA-MEM; SNP/individual filtering (missingness, heterozygosity, depth, KING kinship via VCFtools); sex-linked region identification (RADsex v1.2); population structure (adegenet glPCA, ADMIXTURE v1.3.0, SnapClust, triangulaR hybrid index); differentiation (dartR F_ST with 999 bootstraps); and spatiotemporal composition modelling (chi-squared tests, mclogit baseline-category multinomial logit models with AICc selection). Tissue sampling, DNA extraction (DNeasy/Qiagen), PicoGreen quantification, ddRAD library preparation (PstI/MspI, Poland et al. 2012) and NovaSeq X PE150 sequencing are wet-lab (W, out of scope for computational reproduction).
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool extraction from the bioRxiv v1 JATS source XML, retrieved by curl of https://www.biorxiv.org/content/early/2025/12/02/2025.12.01.686997.source.xml (HTTP 200 with a browser User-Agent; WebFetch on the same URL returned HTTP 403). Methods sections 'Sampling', 'Genotyping' (DNA extraction / SNPs datasets / Sex-linked genomic regions), 'Characterizing the genomic population structure' and 'Spatiotemporal variation of genomic population structure' were read in full, plus the Data availability statement. The paper has NO Code availability section; the Data availability statement says only that 'The scripts to obtain SNP panels from raw reads and perform analyses will be available on Zenodo' - no Zenodo DOI, record ID or URL is given anywhere, so no repository landing page or README prose could be read. All code-axis scores are therefore prose-only judgements: code=1 where a named public tool is invoked with recoverable intent, code=0 where the step is custom author code (dataset derivation, chi-squared tests) with no released script. Several detailed filtration thresholds are stated to be in Table 2, whose per-step numbers were not machine-extractable from the XML; the prose thresholds that are given inline were used. Wet-lab steps (tissue sampling/preservation, DNA extraction + quantification, ddRAD library prep + NovaSeq sequencing) counted in W (3), not verdicted.

steps.label: Raw read quality assessment with FastQC (Andrews 2010) - no version, no parameters stated
Aggregation of per-sample QC reports with MultiQC (Ewels et al. 2016) - no version, no parameters stated
Illumina adaptor removal with Trimmomatic (Bolger et al. 2014) - no version, no adapter file, no ILLUMINACLIP/SLIDINGWINDOW/MINLEN settings stated
Demultiplexing of ddRAD reads with the STACKS v2.55 process_radtags module, truncation at 120 bp (28 libraries of 96 samples, 2 NovaSeq X PE150 lanes)

Alignment of demultiplexed reads to the chromosome-level Sebastes aleutianus reference genome (Kolora et al. 2021) with BWA-MEM (Li and Durbin 2009), 'default parameters' - no BWA version, no reference assembly accession or version stated
SNP catalog construction and genotyping of all good-quality samples with the STACKS v2.55 gstacks module - per-step counts referred to Table 2, no command line stated
SNP export and shared-locus filtering with the STACKS v2.55 populations module (r = 0.75, i.e. SNPs shared by >75% of individuals; MAF 0.01)

Post-STACKS SNP and individual filtering with VCFtools (Danecek et al. 2011): SNP missingness <10%, individual missingness <30%, observed heterozygosity >0.6 removed, depth outside 10x-51x removed, individuals <5x coverage removed, and relatedness pruning with the KING kinship estimator (Manichaikul et al. 2010, Phi > 0.3) implemented in VCFtools - no VCFtools version, no command lines, order of filters not fully specified

Derivation of the three analysis datasets (Sebastes spp., S. mentella, S. fasciatus) at MAF 1% or 5%, thinned to one SNP per locus, with introgressed individuals and sex-linked SNPs removed - 'see Table 2 for detailed filtration steps'; no tool named for the thinning/subsetting, no script released

Sex-linked locus detection with RADsex v1.2 (Feron et al. 2021) on demultiplexed reads of sexed individuals (S. mentella N = 783, S. fasciatus N = 479), minimum depth 5 reads, Bonferroni correction, sex-biased reads then mapped back to the S. aleutianus genome

Principal component analysis with the glPCA function of the R package adegenet (Jombart 2008), applied to the Sebastes spp., S. mentella and S. fasciatus datasets - no adegenet version, no R version, no glPCA arguments (nf, centring/scaling) stated

Model-based clustering with ADMIXTURE v1.3.0 (Alexander et al. 2009): K = 3 on the Sebastes spp. dataset, and cross-validation over K for the species-specific datasets (results reported at K = 4, 5 and 7)

Species assignment and hybrid detection with SnapClust (Beugin et al. 2018): K = 3 on the full Sebastes spp. dataset, then K = 2 with hybrid detection on the S. norvegicus-excluded subset, and choose.cluster over K = 1-10 per species - no SnapClust/adegenet version, no seed, no max.iter or hybrid-class settings stated

Hybrid index and interclass heterozygosity of the 31 putatively introgressed individuals with the triangulaR R package (Wiens et al. 2025) - no version, no allele-frequency-difference threshold, no parameters stated

Genetic differentiation (F_ST) among species and among within-species genetic groups with the dartR R package (Gruber et al. 2018), confidence intervals from 999 bootstraps - no dartR version, no F_ST estimator variant, no seed stated

Chi-squared tests of genetic-group proportions by body-length class (<28 cm vs >=28 cm) and by management unit, plus 2010s-cohort assignment from fork-length windows taken from stock assessments (2018: 20-23 cm, 2020: 22-24 cm, 2021: 23-25 cm) - base-R analysis, no script released, no software version

Baseline-category multinomial logit models (Agresti 2002) of species / genetic-group proportions against depth, management unit and their interaction, fitted with the mclogit R package (Elff 2024) and compared by AICc - no mclogit version, no R version, no model formulas, random-effect structure or AICc implementation stated; model tables are in Supplementary Tables S1-S3

headline.static_readiness: 0/17 (0%) - stage1 ceiling only, no R-star (R-star needs stage-2 code verification)
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: RI ceiling on 5/17 computational steps. Only three tools carry exact version pins in prose: STACKS v2.55 (covering process_radtags, gstacks and populations, i.e. steps C4, C6, C7), RADsex v1.2 (C10) and ADMIXTURE v1.3.0 (C12). The remaining 12/17 steps cap at NI because no version is given for FastQC, MultiQC, Trimmomatic, BWA-MEM, VCFtools, adegenet/glPCA, SnapClust, triangulaR, dartR or mclogit, and because two steps (dataset derivation to one SNP per locus; chi-squared / cohort-assignment analysis) are custom author code with no released script. No environment lockfile, conda specification or container is claimed anywhere in the paper, and the R version is never stated, so version is capped at 1 even for the pinned tools and no step can exceed RI at stage 2. The Data availability statement promises that 'The scripts to obtain SNP panels from raw reads and perform analyses will be available on Zenodo', but gives no Zenodo DOI or record, so no code artifact exists to verify.
headline.coverage: 17 computational analysis steps assessed from the bioRxiv v1 JATS Methods prose (Genotyping / SNPs datasets / Sex-linked genomic regions / Characterizing the genomic population structure / Spatiotemporal variation sections). 3 wet-lab steps (tissue sampling and ethanol preservation with fork-length and sex recording; DNeasy DNA extraction and PicoGreen quantification on a Synergy LX; ddRAD PstI/MspI library preparation per Poland et al. 2012 and NovaSeq X PE150 sequencing with 10% PhiX) counted in W but out of computational-reproduction scope.

gaps.where: Whole analysis pipeline (Data availability statement; no Code availability section exists)
gaps.missing: No code repository is identified. The paper states verbatim: 'The scripts to obtain SNP panels from raw reads and perform analyses will be available on Zenodo.' This is a future-tense promise with no Zenodo DOI, no record ID, no URL, and no repository name; there is nothing to fetch or read. The STACKS/BWA driver scripts, the VCFtools filtering commands, the dataset-derivation code behind Table 2, and all R analysis code (adegenet PCA, SnapClust, triangulaR, dartR F_ST, chi-squared tests, mclogit model set and AICc comparison, all figures) are therefore unavailable.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the pipeline and R analysis scripts on Zenodo (or a git repository archived to Zenodo), and cite the concrete DOI in a Code availability statement rather than a future-tense promise.

gaps.missing: No environment capture of any kind is claimed: no conda/mamba environment file, no conda-lock or pixi lockfile, no renv.lock, no Dockerfile or container image digest, no HPC module list. The R version is never stated anywhere, although at least six analyses (adegenet, SnapClust, triangulaR, dartR, mclogit, base-R chi-squared) run inside R. The BWA, VCFtools and Trimmomatic builds are likewise uncharacterised.
gaps.how_to_close: Ship a conda-lock/pixi lockfile plus an renv.lock (or a container image referenced by sha256 digest) covering the STACKS/BWA/VCFtools/RADsex/ADMIXTURE stack and the full R package set, and state the R version.

gaps.missing: Version pins absent for FastQC, MultiQC, Trimmomatic, BWA(-MEM), VCFtools, adegenet, SnapClust, triangulaR, dartR and mclogit, and for R itself. Only STACKS v2.55, RADsex v1.2 and ADMIXTURE v1.3.0 are pinned. In addition, the Sebastes aleutianus reference genome (Kolora et al. 2021) is cited only as a reference, with no assembly accession, no assembly version and no NCBI/GenBank identifier - a reference-data pin that directly determines every downstream coordinate reported in the sex-linked region results (e.g. 'scaffold 72_5: 30,232,885-32,799,890').
gaps.how_to_close: Pin every tool and R package version and give the exact reference-genome assembly accession and version used for BWA-MEM alignment.

gaps.missing: Most invocations are named without a command line. Trimmomatic is run with no stated adapter file or clipping/quality settings. gstacks is run with no parameters ('to create a SNPs catalog and to genotype all good quality samples'). The VCFtools filter sequence is described as thresholds but not as commands, and the order in which SNP-level and individual-level filters were applied is not specified. glPCA arguments, SnapClust settings beyond K, triangulaR's allele-frequency-difference threshold, dartR's F_ST estimator, ADMIXTURE's cross-validation fold count, and the exact mclogit model formulas (including the interaction parameterisation and the AICc implementation used) are all unstated. The detailed per-stage filtration numbers are delegated to Table 2, which is not reproduced in the Methods prose.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish the exact command lines and R scripts for every step, including the full filter order, all default-overriding arguments, and the model formulas compared by AICc.

gaps.missing: No random seeds are reported for any stochastic step: ADMIXTURE cross-validation and its K-wise runs, SnapClust's EM-style clustering and choose.cluster search over K = 1-10, and the 999-bootstrap F_ST confidence intervals in dartR are all seed-dependent. Because the resolution of the reported structure (K = 5 for S. mentella, K = 7 for S. fasciatus, and the reconciliation of partially disagreeing ADMIXTURE and SnapClust assignments) is the paper's central result, the absence of seeds materially limits bitwise re-derivation.
gaps.how_to_close: Report seeds (and number of independent runs per K) for ADMIXTURE, SnapClust and the dartR bootstrap.

gaps.where: Step C5 (reference genome) and the 'References' sample set
gaps.missing: Two externally-held inputs are not pinned. (1) The Sebastes aleutianus chromosome-level assembly used for alignment is cited only by publication (Kolora et al. 2021); the assembly version determines the scaffold names and coordinates used throughout the sex-linked results. (2) The 394 reference redfish from Benestan et al. (2021) plus 35 S. norvegicus are re-used from prior work with no accession given for their raw reads or genotypes, so the reference panel that defines the ecotype labels cannot be reassembled from this paper alone.
gaps.how_to_close: Cite the exact reference-assembly accession/version, and give the accessions (or a merged deposit) for the re-used Benestan et al. 2021 reference individuals and the S. norvegicus samples.

gaps.missing: The statement reads 'Raw sequence data for the ddRAD datasets will be available in the Sequence Read Archive (SRA) under the BioProject accession no. PRJNA1208513' - future tense, with no URL and no per-sample run accession table. There is no mapping from the 2,660 individuals + 28 duplicates, the 28 libraries, or the four sampling collections (2005 survey, 2018 survey, 2020 industry survey, 2021 commercial) to individual SRA runs, and no deposit of the filtered VCFs or of the three final SNP datasets used for analysis. Sample metadata (management unit, depth, fork length, sex, year), which is the response and predictor data for every model in the paper, is not deposited anywhere.
gaps.how_to_close: Release the BioProject publicly with a per-individual run accession table, and deposit the three final SNP datasets (VCF) together with the per-individual metadata table (unit, depth, length, sex, year, assigned genetic group).

gaps.missing: Tissue sampling (fin or muscle) with 95% ethanol preservation plus fork-length and sex recording; DNA extraction with DNeasy Blood and Tissue / DNeasy 96 (Qiagen) and PicoGreen quantification on a Synergy LX (BioTek) with a quality-based selection whose acceptance threshold is not stated; ddRAD library preparation (PstI + MspI, 20 ng DNA per sample, Poland et al. 2012 protocol) by the Plateforme d'Analyse Genomique (IBIS, Universite Laval), pooling into 28 libraries of 96 samples, and sequencing on two NovaSeq X PE150 lanes with 10% PhiX at Genome Quebec. These are physical steps, out of scope for computational reproduction; counted in W (3), not verdicted.
gaps.how_to_close: N/A for Tier-1 computational readiness; the deposited SRA reads (PRJNA1208513) are the intended computational entry point once released.

gaps.missing: Because no repository or Zenodo record exists yet, there is no tagged release, no archival DOI and no license for any of the analysis code. The only external code pointer anywhere in the paper is the mclogit package homepage (github.com/melff/mclogit) appearing in the reference list - third-party software, not author code, and cited without a version or commit.
gaps.how_to_close: Create a licensed repository, archive a tagged release to Zenodo, and cite the resulting DOI in the paper.
